shots.text: We beat him three times, and the third time he broke and ran back into his fortress. Now it was our turn. We left the towers to hold the camp and sent everyone we had at his gate.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Vael-Orrun, half beast, fleeing through the fortress gate. The heroes and the Concord's troops forming up in front of the towers.

shots.text: Gates are my trade. Let me.
shots.speaker: brannoc
shots.art_note: Brannoc walking out in front of the army toward the fortress gate, hammer glowing.
